archetype: Multi-platform intelligence dashboard with agent-readiness as first-class invariant

top_level_directories.api/: Vercel Edge Functions (self-contained JS, per-domain bundling, no node: imports, no cross-dir imports)
top_level_directories.server/: Server-side code bundled into Edge Functions (gateway.ts, router.ts, _shared/, worldmonitor/<domain>/handlers)
top_level_directories.src/: Browser SPA (TypeScript) — components, services, workers, config, generated proto stubs
top_level_directories.src-tauri/: Tauri 2 desktop shell (Rust) + Node.js sidecar (local API server)
top_level_directories.proto/: Protobuf service definitions (sebuf framework, 281 protos, 35 services)
top_level_directories.convex/: Convex backend (entitlements, API keys, user prefs, webhooks, followed-countries locking)
top_level_directories.scripts/: Seed scripts (Railway), build helpers, AIS relay service
top_level_directories.cli/: Official worldmonitor npm CLI (zero-dep ESM, MCP-first)
top_level_directories.sdk/: SDK ecosystems: python/, ruby/, go/ (OIDC trusted publishing)
top_level_directories.workers/: Cloudflare Workers (edge CORS preflight for api.worldmonitor.app)

boundary_enforcement: Edge Function self-containment: tests/edge-functions.test.mjs rejects node: built-in imports, ../server/ and ../src/ cross-directory imports
Pre-push esbuild bundle check per endpoint
proto-check.yml CI enforces generated code freshness (make generate must match committed output)
lint:api-contract enforces api/api-route-exceptions.json — hand-written endpoints that cannot be proto-defined are explicitly listed
docs:check CI enforces ARCHITECTURE.md capability counts against stats.json
structure.module_organization: Domain-driven: api/<domain>/v<N>/[rpc].ts mirrors proto/<domain>/ structure, server/worldmonitor/<domain>/v1/handler.ts holds handler logic. Domains include aviation, climate, conflict, cyber, economic, energy, maritime, military, natural-disasters, etc.

request_lifecycle.entry: Vercel Edge Function (api/<domain>/v<N>/[rpc].ts) or operational endpoint (api/<op>.ts)
pipeline: API key validation (origin-aware: desktop requires key, trusted browser exempt)
Rate limiting (endpoint-specific, then global fallback) — Upstash sliding window
Route matching (Map O(1) static → linear dynamic {param} scan)
request_lifecycle.cache_path: Bootstrap seed (Railway→Redis) → in-memory (per Vercel instance) → Redis (cross-instance, cachedFetchJson coalesces concurrent misses) → upstream API fetch (result cached back + seed-meta written)

mcp_request_lifecycle.anonymous_phase: initialize + publicMethods (tools/list, prompts/list, resources/list, ping, logging/setLevel) — no auth required, agent-readiness discovery surface
mcp_request_lifecycle.authenticated_phase: tools/call — requires X-WorldMonitor-Key header or OAuth; Pro/user_key contexts get INCR-first quota reservation (50/day cap, resets UTC midnight)
mcp_request_lifecycle.tool_execution: tool._execute (RPC tools) or executeTool (cache tools reading Upstash directly); JMESPath projection; budget gate (utf8ByteLength vs _outputBudgetBytes); no-refund on error (GHSA-hcq5)

behavior.spa_init: 8 phases: Storage+i18n → ML Worker (ONNX) → Sidecar (desktop only) → Bootstrap (2-tier concurrent, fast 3s + slow 5s) → Layout → UI → Data (parallel loadAllData + viewport-conditional primeVisiblePanelData) → Refresh (variant-specific polling, exponential backoff max 4x, viewport-conditional, tab-pause)
behavior.seed_loops: Railway AIS relay runs continuous seed loops: market data, aviation delays, positive events, GPSJAM, risk scores (CII), UCDP events. Each uses atomicPublish (Redis SET NX lock → validate → write key → write seed-meta → release lock).
behavior.desktop_runtime: Tauri Rust shell (lifecycle, system tray, IPC) → Node.js sidecar on dynamic port → dynamically loads Edge Function handler modules from api/ → injects keyring secrets via env vars → monkey-patches globalThis.fetch to force IPv4 (government APIs have broken IPv6). Renderer fetch patch routes /api/* to sidecar with 5-min TTL Bearer token; falls back to cloud API on sidecar failure.

state_ownership.Upstash Redis: Cache layer (4-tier), stampede protection (cachedFetchJson coalescing), seed-meta freshness tracking, rate limiting (sliding window), internal-MCP replay nonce cache, idempotency keys
state_ownership.Convex: Entitlements (Pro/Enterprise tier gating), API keys (hashed), user preferences (with syncVersion optimistic concurrency), followed-countries (sharded + TTL-locked), contact form, waitlist, webhooks (payments, Resend)
state_ownership.Railway: AIS WebSocket relay, seed loop processes, consumer-prices Playwright scrapers
state_ownership.Browser AppContext: Map references, panel instances, panel/layer settings, cached data (news/markets/predictions/clusters), in-flight request tracking, UI component references
state_ownership.URL state: Bidirectional sync with AppContext (debounced 250ms) via urlState.ts
state_ownership.Platform keyring: Desktop secrets (macOS Keychain, Windows Credential Manager, Linux keyring) — never plaintext

deployment_ownership.Vercel: SPA hosting + Edge Functions + middleware (bot filtering, social OG)
deployment_ownership.Cloudflare: CORS preflight worker (api.worldmonitor.app) + zone config (apex→www redirect with exemption list)
deployment_ownership.Railway: AIS relay + seed loops + consumer prices
deployment_ownership.GHCR: Multi-arch Docker image (nginx serving built SPA, proxies API to upstream)
deployment_ownership.Tauri: Desktop binaries (macOS ARM64/x64, Windows x64, Linux x64/ARM64)

ownership.ci_ownership: 20+ GitHub workflows. deploy-gate.yml aggregates required smoke-gate statuses onto head SHA for branch protection. mcp-live-smoke.yml (6-hourly) is the regression net for #4937/#4938. seed-freshness-monitor.yml (15-min cron) checks production seed metadata freshness.

agent_readiness.mcp_server: https://worldmonitor.app/mcp (Streamable HTTP). Public tools/list; tools/call authenticates with X-WorldMonitor-Key or OAuth.
agent_readiness.rfc_9728: Protected-resource metadata (oauth-protected-resource.ts) — host-derived with spoofing guard
agent_readiness.rfc_8414: Authorization-server metadata (oauth-authorization-server.ts) — host-derived with spoofing guard
agent_readiness.a2a_endpoint: api/a2a.ts — agent-to-agent communication with token-overlap concierge routing

sdk_ecosystem.npm_cli: worldmonitor package (cli/), zero-dep ESM, MCP-first, OIDC trusted publishing
sdk_ecosystem.python_sdk: worldmonitor-sdk (sdk/python/), PyPI, OIDC trusted publishing with attestations
sdk_ecosystem.ruby_sdk: worldmonitor gem (sdk/ruby/), RubyGems OIDC trusted publishing

extension.variant_system: 6 site variants (world, tech, finance, commodity, happy, energy) from single codebase. Detected by hostname or localStorage on desktop. Controls: default panels, map layers, refresh intervals, theme, UI text. Variant change resets all settings to defaults.
extension_points: New upstream provider: seed script + Redis key + health check + (optional) proto RPC + panel
New RPC: proto definition + buf generate + handler + gateway route + edge function file
New site variant: hostname detection + variant config + CI build matrix
New MCP tool: registry entry + (optional) _execute + quota policy + describe_tool exemption check
New domain: api/<domain>/ directory + server/worldmonitor/<domain>/ handler + proto/<domain>/ definitions

documented_changes: Filesystem-based routing replacing manual route tables (per ARCHITECTURE.md ownership rule + repository-model.json)
ES modules migration (type: module) — no CommonJS require()
Agent-readiness discovery layer added to API surface (MCP, RFC 9728/8414, llms.txt, agent-skills, api-catalog)
Custom lint tooling for boundary/contract enforcement (lint:api-contract, edge-functions.test.mjs guardrails)
Per-domain Edge Function bundling via esbuild (claimed ~20× cold-start reduction)
'live' cache tier (60s) added for energy-atlas live-tanker map layer — shorter than existing 'fast' (300s) tier, kept untouched to avoid impacting unrelated endpoints
issue_driven_invariants: #4937: MCP anonymous/authenticated method split — a 401 on a gated method hangs MCP SDK transports to 30s timeout
#4938: Cloudflare apex→www redirect breaks OAuth dynamic client registration — a redirected POST becomes GET and dies with 405
GHSA-hcq5: No-refund on tool execution error — refunding let Pro token bypass daily cap by driving calls that reliably error after costly fetch
#4497: live-api-cache-auth.yml regression net — fake auth stays no-store and never cached 200; was inert until #5379 wired the gate on
#4838: api/_agent-tool-suggest.ts kept as route-less helper (underscore prefix) so neither A2A nor /ask cold-start depends on the other's module-level guards
evolution.missing_history: No ADR (Architecture Decision Record) directory. Decision rationale (why token-overlap not NLU, why AGPL, why 5-platform split) lives in code comments and ARCHITECTURE.md prose, not structured decision records. Issue numbers (#4937, #4938, GHSA-hcq5) are the closest thing to decision provenance.
